description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Determination Made by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under Section 44(9) and 44(10) of the Banking (Special Provision) Act No. 17 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette contains determinations made by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Banking (Special Provisions) Act, No.17 of 2023. It establishes regulatory frameworks for deposit insurance compensation, sets maximum compensation amounts, defines claim submission deadlines, and repeals previous regulations. This content falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements for the banking sector.
